exposure: Conversion of epidural analgesia to anesthesia during cesarean section
outcome: Neonatal Neurobehavioral Assessment Scale (NACS) score at 15 minutes, 2 hours, 24 hours, and 72 hours
cohort: 143 newborns of mothers who underwent conversion of epidural analgesia to anesthesia for cesarean section.
finding: Conversion of epidural analgesia to anesthesia during cesarean section is safe for the fetus and newborn when using 20.0 ml of 2% lidocaine in combination with 0.1 mg of epinephrine or 20.0 ml of 0.5% bupivacaine, or 0.75% ropivacaine in a volume of 20.0 ml.
